reproducedProblems.hypothesis: page-absolute overlay boxes go stale for position:fixed content under window scroll: a fixed element's document-absolute position changes with scrollY and nothing in the product observes scroll
reproducedProblems.reproduction: audit.html #g11-fixed-box; settle all debounced repositions at scrollY=0, window.scrollTo(0,800), wait 800ms, compare .hl box geometry against live Range.getClientRects() of the address substring

reproducedProblems.hypothesis: scrolling an overflow:auto container moves text relative to the document but produces no MutationObserver record, no layout-shift entry and no transition event, so page-absolute boxes drift silently
reproducedProblems.reproduction: audit.html scrollers (single, doubly-nested, horizontal); drive container scroll, compare box vs live rect

reproducedProblems.hypothesis: viem retries TimeoutError by default (shouldRetry returns true, retryCount defaults to 3), so a hung connection holds the card skeleton for ~4x12s before surfacing anything
reproducedProblems.reproduction: mock RPC rule action=hang on eth_getBalance; hover the address; time the response
reproducedProblems.measured: 49.1s to RPC_TIMEOUT pre-fix (12s timeout x 4 attempts + backoff); 12.02s post-fix

fixedProblems.fix: scanner.ts: classify each match entry at creation (and on full reposition passes) as viewport-anchored (fixed/sticky ancestor) and/or scroller-anchored (nearest overflow:auto/scroll ancestor); a capture-phase passive scroll listener marks dirty window/element targets; an interval-throttled (≥50ms between passes, plus one 150ms settle pass) SUBSET reposition touches only scroll-sensitive entries. Pages without scroll-sensitive matches pay a single Set.size check per scroll event. No polling; no full-page traversal per scroll event.
fixedProblems.regression: e2e/audit/geometry.mjs G10-G14: maxDelta 0.00px post-fix; detect 21/21, lifecycle 16/16, verify 31/31 unchanged

fixedProblems.fix: chain.ts: transport http(..., { retryCount: 0 }) — one attempt, then the stable RPC_TIMEOUT code; the stale-balance refresh path already covers transient provider hiccups
fixedProblems.regression: e2e/audit/rpc-privacy.mjs R5: RPC_TIMEOUT surfaces in ~12s (was ~49s); all other error mappings unchanged

unresolvedProblems.detail: MV3 idle termination cannot be exercised under a CDP-attached harness: an attached DevTools-equivalent session disables idle shutdown, and stopAllWorkers/closeTarget did not remove the worker target. Termination→restart is therefore covered indirectly (cold start in every suite; chrome.runtime.reload() lifecycle in mv3.mjs M5). storage.session persistence across SW termination relies on Chrome's documented session-scoped guarantee.

classifyAnchor recognizes only overflow:auto|scroll ancestors: a programmatic scrollTop change on an overflow:hidden container is not tracked (identical to pre-fix behavior); body-level overflow propagating the viewport scroller can classify an entry as scroller-anchored against the body - harmless, one extra subset reposition with correct geometry.

unresolvedProblems.scope: documented product limitations, verified as non-crashing and non-mis-detecting
